subject: PRD alignment: Guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1 scope) + definition of “first production launch”

body:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: PRD alignment: Guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1 scope) + definition of “first production launch”

Alex, Marissa — sharing the PRD draft for the guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1: Hosted API, self-serve). I’d like to lock scope + the “first production launch” definition this week so design/console can proceed without churn.

PRD (draft v0.7): Confluence (draft): Guided onboarding checklist PRD v0.7

What I need from you both:
1) Confirm Phase 1 scope boundaries are right (Hosted API only; Dedicated/Private explicitly out).
2) Agree on the minimum bar for “first production launch” (definition + checklist steps).
3) Confirm success metric definitions (TTFS, funnel completion) so telemetry is consistent.

Current proposed Phase 1 checklist steps (grouped):
- Setup: Create API key; install SDK
- First success: Make first successful request (200); try streaming
- Basics: Handle errors (401/429/timeouts) with retries/timeouts; review rate limits/quotas
- Operate: Visit usage dashboard; set basic monitoring/alerts; establish rollback/fallback guidance
- Launch: Create prod-mode key + “production launch” attestation (more below)

Open question: should “retries/timeouts” be its own validated step, or folded into Production Launch (manual attestation + docs)?

Proposed “first production launch” (v0.7):
- A project is considered “production” when it uses a prod-mode API key and is sending sustained traffic beyond exploratory testing (e.g., non-trivial volume over >=24h), with minimal safeguards in place.

If you can reply with: (a) “approve” / (b) edits to scope/definition / (c) any blockers, I’ll incorporate and mark PRD ready.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Product, Hosted API
Redwood Inference


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: PRD alignment: Guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1 scope) + definition of “first production launch”

Thanks Nikhil — read through v0.7.

Scope: +1 to Hosted API only for Phase 1. Please explicitly call out “no Dedicated/Private validation” in the Problem/Non-goals section (right now it’s in one place but easy to miss).

On “first production launch” definition:
- I’m nervous about any definition that uses “>=24h sustained traffic” because we can’t reliably detect that in the short term without overfitting to small apps / cron jobs. It also creates a laggy validation signal.
- From Console POV, we need something we can either validate quickly or treat as manual attestation.

Suggestion:
- “Production launch” = the user intentionally flips to prod mode (prod API key + confirms they’ve added basic safeguards) AND we’ve seen at least one successful request using that prod key.

Re retries/timeouts:
- I’d keep it as part of Launch, but link out to a canonical snippet page (Python/TS/Go) to avoid writing bespoke copy per step. Otherwise we end up maintaining three mini-guides inside the checklist.

Also: we should add one explicit step for “understand 429s / quotas” since support says that’s a top confusion point.

Marissa
PM, Console & Rollouts


---

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 11:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: PRD alignment: Guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1 scope) + definition of “first production launch”

Agree with Marissa on avoiding a time-based definition for Phase 1.

Two things I want tightened before signoff:

1) What exactly is the minimum “safeguards” list?
If we’re asking users to attest to it, it must be short and defensible. I don’t want this to become a 15-item SRE checklist.

2) What’s our official KPI definition for “time to first success” and “time to first production launch”?
- TTFS: first 200 response from Hosted API? Do we exclude calls that fail due to auth (401)? Do we include embeddings? (We should decide.)
- Production: if we define it as “first successful request using prod-mode key”, we need to be careful we’re not incentivizing people to create a prod key too early.

If you can respond with the crisp definitions + the minimum safeguards list, I’m happy to approve.

Alex
VP, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference


---

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 12:46 PM PT
Subject: Re: PRD alignment: Guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1 scope) + definition of “first production launch”

Super helpful — proposed updates below.

A) “First production launch” definition (Phase 1, measurable + not laggy)
Definition v1 (recommended):
- “First production launch” occurs when a user (1) creates a prod-mode API key for a project, (2) confirms a short safeguards attestation (in Console), and (3) we observe at least one successful Hosted API request (HTTP 200) authenticated with that prod-mode key.

Rationale:
- Avoids time-based criteria.
- Keeps “prod” tied to intent + minimal hygiene.
- Validatable with existing gateway logs/metrics + key metadata.

B) Minimum safeguards attestation (keep it short)
Proposed 5-item minimum (checkboxes in Console, all linked to canonical docs):
1. Timeouts configured in client (SDK default or explicit).
2. Retries/backoff configured for retryable errors (429/5xx/timeout) within documented limits.
3. Basic monitoring enabled: know where to view usage + errors (usage dashboard link + “set an alert” doc).
4. Rate limit / quota awareness: understand 429 handling and where quotas are configured.
5. Rollback/fallback plan: know how to pin model version and revert (link to rollouts doc; for Phase 1 this is “manual rollback guidance”, not fully validated).

We can keep “rollbacks” as knowledge/links for Hosted API; not asking for canary, etc., in Phase 1.

C) KPI definitions (for telemetry + dashboards)
TTFS (time to first success):
- From signup timestamp to first successful Hosted API request (HTTP 200) using any non-prod key, for text generation/chat endpoints only.
- Excludes auth failures (401/403) and rate limit (429) events; those are tracked as blockers but not “success”.

Time to first production launch:
- From signup timestamp to “first production launch” event as defined in (A).

Open question (minor): include embeddings as “first success”? My preference is no for Phase 1 to keep it aligned with the quickstart path; we can add a separate “first embeddings call” optional step later.

Marissa: I’ll incorporate your callout to add an explicit “Quotas & 429s” step.

Alex/Marissa: if this looks acceptable, can you reply “approved” so I can mark PRD locked and unblock UX spec work?

Nikhil

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 2:09 PM PT
Subject: Re: PRD alignment: Guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1 scope) + definition of “first production launch”

Approved from me with two small notes to bake into PRD:

1) For production launch validation: make sure “first 200 using prod-mode key” is per-project, not per-org. Otherwise multi-project orgs get weird.

2) On the safeguards attestation: +1 to keeping it at 5, but I’d like the UI copy to be framed as “confirm you have…” not “you must…”, and we should add “Learn more” links for each item (don’t try to explain retries in 2 lines).

If you add those clarifications, Console team can treat this as the source of truth.

Marissa

Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 3:47 PM PT
Subject: Re: PRD alignment: Guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1 scope) + definition of “first production launch”

Approved.

Please make the KPI definitions extremely explicit (endpoint scope, per-project, and how we treat missing telemetry / lag) so Analytics doesn’t have to guess.

Also: keep embeddings out of TTFS for now as you suggested. We can add it as an optional “next step” later.

Once you’ve updated the PRD, drop the link in PM-482 and tag Marissa + me so we know it’s the locked version.

Alex
